clue.text: Joseph, with Bob, stays with the ritual burners

parts.note: Jos is a familiar shortening of the name Joseph
a bob was a shilling in old British money, abbreviated s
stays and sticks both mean remains in place

explanation.surface: A man called Joseph and his friend Bob hang around with the people burning incense at a rite.
explanation.walkthrough: A bob is slang for a shilling, the old British coin worth a twentieth of a pound, written s.
explanation.definitionFit: These sticks of incense are burned in temples and shrines as part of religious ceremony.

clue.text: Prize potman

explanation.definitionFit: To prize a lid off is to lever it up, as a jack does; and a jack was an old name for a serving man or tavern boy.

clue.text: A dotty way to cancel the cancellation

definitions.text: A dotty way to cancel the cancellation

parts.words: A dotty way to cancel the cancellation
parts.note: a proofreader who wants struck-out text restored puts a row of dots beneath it and writes a Latin word meaning let it stand

explanation.definitionFit: The proofreader's mark, with its dots under the deleted words, undoes a deletion.

clue.text: It's the solid way to view Corot's pieces

indicators.note: the painter's pieces are to be viewed afresh, seen in another arrangement of their letters

parts.note: the painter Corot's name with its possessive s

explanation.surface: Seeing a French painter's works the right way gives a three-dimensional impression.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to view' signals the anagram of COROTS plus PIECES; 'pieces' looks like the signal but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A stereoscope merges two pictures into one image that looks three-dimensional, a solid-seeming way of seeing.

clue.text: Fibre to repair a stile

indicators.note: mending the stile means putting its letters back in a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A farmer needs some fibre to mend a broken stile in a field.
explanation.walkthrough: A stile is the step for climbing over a field fence; 'a' is only a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: Istle is a tough plant fibre from Mexican agave, used for cords and brushes.

clue.text: He's frequently in the doghouse !

parts.note: being in the doghouse usually means being in disgrace, but here it is a literal kennel worked in daily

explanation.definitionFit: A man who looks after hounds in a kennel spends his working day among the dog shelters.

clue.text: Friends of Lord Greystoke's youth

parts.note: Lord Greystoke is the title of Tarzan, who was raised in the jungle by primates

explanation.definitionFit: Tarzan grew up among primates, so his boyhood companions were simians.

clue.text: He's liable to stealthy thoughts, in three words

definitions.text: He's liable to stealthy thoughts, in three words

parts.words: He's liable to stealthy thoughts, in three words
parts.note: split stealthy into three words, steal thy, and the clue says he is liable to steal thy thoughts

explanation.definitionFit: Someone who passes off other people's ideas as their own steals their thoughts.

clue.text: Porosity of a parasite?

parts.note: a sponger is a parasite living off others, so his quality could be named from sponging as well as from a porous sponge

explanation.definitionFit: Being full of holes like a sponge is porosity; the question mark points at the sponger's habit too.

clue.text: The clue gives your shoe-size, my darling

definitions.text: The clue gives your shoe-size, my darling

parts.words: The clue gives your shoe-size, my darling
parts.note: the clue number is 9, and the old song says of its darling heroine that her shoes were number nine

explanation.walkthrough: The American folk song 'Oh My Darling' has a miner's daughter whose shoes were 'number nine'; this is clue 9.
explanation.definitionFit: The heroine of the old American ballad is addressed as 'my darling' and wore size nine shoes.

clue.text: Jack gets nothing for the plant

parts.note: a jack tar, or tar, is a sailor
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A sailor is given nothing in return for a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Taro is a tropical plant grown for its starchy edible root.

clue.text: Furniture movers, noisy but spirited !

parts.note: reads as a lively removal crew, but means ghosts that throw tables and chairs about with a racket

explanation.definitionFit: These noisy spirits of folklore are said to bang about and shift household objects.

clue.text: Russian woman making long strides to achieve a new build-up

parts.note: red was the usual shorthand for a Soviet Russian or communist
Eve, the first woman, is a common crossword woman
loping is running with long easy strides

explanation.surface: A Soviet woman strides along purposefully to rebuild something.
explanation.definitionFit: Building an area up again with new construction is the planner's word for renewal.

clue.text: See dangers to royalty in such invasions …

parts.note: to spot is to see
in chess a check is a threat to the king

explanation.surface: Someone notices threats to the monarch in a set of raids.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue runs on into 14: such invasions of these repositories, unannounced inspections of stockrooms.
explanation.definitionFit: Surprise inspections burst in on premises without warning, like small raids.

clue.text: . of these repositories

parts.note: carries on from 13: the surprise inspections are made of the places where goods are kept

explanation.definitionFit: Rooms for keeping supplies and stock are places of safekeeping.

clue.text: Soap I must use, it's elementary

indicators.note: putting the letters to new use rearranges them

explanation.surface: A recipe: you have to use some soap, which is a simple matter.
explanation.definitionFit: This alkali metal is a chemical element, and potash soaps are made from its compounds.

clue.text: Disguised as to coining, a name

definitions.text: Disguised as to coining, a name

indicators.note: disguising the words changes their form, so their letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone in disguise makes up a false name for himself.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is the definition too: travelling under a coined name is being disguised as regards your name.
explanation.definitionFit: Travelling under an assumed name keeps one's true identity concealed.

clue.text: Discovered by some venturing into Italy

definitions.text: Discovered by some venturing into Italy

indicators.note: the city is uncovered within some of the letters of the following word

explanation.surface: Travellers going into Italy come upon something.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole the clue also defines: a city found by travellers who venture into Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Turin is a major city of northern Italy, in Piedmont.

clue.text: Hill thus dismembered ?

parts.note: a tor is a rocky hill, as on Dartmoor
so means thus

explanation.surface: A hillside is cut up into pieces.
explanation.walkthrough: Read whole, a body with its limbs removed is what is left: the trunk.
explanation.definitionFit: The trunk of a body without head or limbs is what a dismembered statue leaves.

clue.text: You have them here in black and white

definitions.text: You have them here in black and white

parts.words: You have them here in black and white
parts.note: black and white are opposites, and the printed grid sets dark squares against light

explanation.definitionFit: Black and white are the classic opposites, sharply different from one another.

clue.text: 9's sandals

parts.note: in the song named in 9 the heroine's footwear was boxes for fish without their tops

explanation.walkthrough: The song's verse runs: herring boxes without topses, sandals were for her.
explanation.definitionFit: The ballad says the miner's daughter wore fish crates as her sandals.

clue.text: Jock's exclamation about the colour

parts.note: och is a Scottish exclamation; a Jock is a Scotsman
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: A Scotsman protests about a colour scheme.
explanation.walkthrough: Jock is British slang for a Scotsman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ochre is a yellowish-brown earth pigment and its colour.

clue.text: Indian graduate with a head for business

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a graduate

indicators.note: only the front of the word is kept, its first two letters, with the rest dropped

explanation.surface: An Indian with a degree has a talent for commerce.
explanation.walkthrough: A babu was an Indian clerk, often with a degree, in British India.
explanation.definitionFit: Babu was a title for an Indian gentleman or clerk under the Raj.

clue.text: Try another order for 2

indicators.note: another order of letters means a rearrangement

parts.note: the answer to 2 down, the proofreader's let-it-stand mark

explanation.surface: Try a different arrangement for number two.
explanation.definitionFit: To test something is to try it out.

clue.text: The bird to turn on the company

indicators.note: turn means the little word to is reversed

explanation.surface: A bird turns on the group it lives with.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' sets the turned word after the abbreviation.
explanation.definitionFit: The coot is a black water bird with a white forehead.

clue.text: What a deadly lamp-cover !

parts.note: a shade for a lamp lit at night, but deadly points at the poisonous plant belladonna

explanation.definitionFit: Deadly nightshade, belladonna, is a poisonous plant; split, the name is a shade for night lamps.

clue.text: Does it provide support for a see-through get-up ?

definitions.text: Does it provide support for a see-through get-up ?

parts.words: Does it provide support for a see-through get-up ?
parts.note: suggests risque clothing, but means the frame holding the glass of a window that slides up

explanation.definitionFit: The frame holding the glazing of a window that slides up and down is its sash.

clue.text: Turnover in warm weather seasoning seems sound

indicators.note: seems like it in sound, so the words are heard rather than spelt

parts.note: warm weather is summer and seasoning is salt

explanation.surface: Something that turns over in the summer seasoning sounds right.
explanation.definitionFit: A head-over-heels roll is a turn of the body right over.
